title: Unsure what to say, asks to start over
persona: Sophie Tran, thirties, anxious, second-guesses herself, laughs nervously.
goal: Book a ride for her boss's arrival, stalls and backtracks on time and name.
opening_line: Hi, sorry, I'm kind of new at this. I need a car for my boss. At the airport.

turns.caller: He's landing... hold on, let me check my email.
Okay. Wednesday the sixth, landing at, um, four forty. Wait, no, four fifty.
Milwaukee airport. Mitchell? Is that right?
He's going to, uh... ugh, what's the address... the Westin, downtown.
His name is, um... Mr. Daniel Reed.
One bag. Oh wait, he might have two.
Use my number. 414-555-0178. I'm Sophie Tran.
Sorry, can you read it back to me? I got nervous.

hesitation_rules: Stalls with 'hold on' and 'um' on turns 1 and 4, apologizes repeatedly, and finishes the thought on the following turn.
expected: Uses the corrected time of four fifty and two bags
Reads back the details accurately when asked
Distinguishes passenger name from booker name and cell
